The test image shows large irregular dark blotches on red berries (not small discrete spots), aligning with Berry_Blotch's "brown irregular spots sometimes covering the whole berry" and the premature ripening effect. The other 4 leaf-only diseases (Cerscospora, Miner, Phoma, Rust) are not relevant to this pod image.
